paragraphs.en: The AI revolution drove frenzied investment in both private and public companies and captured the public’s imagination in 2023. Transformational consumer products like ChatGPT are powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) that excel at modeling sequences of tokens that represent words or parts of words [2]. Amazingly, structural understanding emerges from learning next-token prediction, and agents are able to complete tasks such as translation, question answering and generating human-like prose from simple user prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 2023 年，AI 革命推动了对私营和上市公司的疯狂投资，并激发了公众的想象力。 像 ChatGPT 这样的变革性消费产品由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动，这类模型擅长对表示单词或词素的词元序列进行建模 [2]。 令人惊叹的是，结构性理解从学习下一个词元预测中涌现出来，智能体能够根据简单的用户提示完成翻译、问答和生成类人文本等任务。

sents.en: The AI revolution drove frenzied investment in both private and public companies and captured the public’s imagination in 2023.
sents.zh: 2023 年，AI 革命推动了对私营和上市公司的疯狂投资，并激发了公众的想象力。

sents.en: Transformational consumer products like ChatGPT are powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) that excel at modeling sequences of tokens that represent words or parts of words [2].
sents.zh: 像 ChatGPT 这样的变革性消费产品由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动，这类模型擅长对表示单词或词素的词元序列进行建模 [2]。

sents.en: Amazingly, structural understanding emerges from learning next-token prediction, and agents are able to complete tasks such as translation, question answering and generating human-like prose from simple user prompts.
sents.zh: 令人惊叹的是，结构性理解从学习下一个词元预测中涌现出来，智能体能够根据简单的用户提示完成翻译、问答和生成类人文本等任务。

paragraphs.en: Not surprisingly, quantitative traders have asked: can we turn these models into the next price or trade prediction [1,9,10]? That is, rather than modeling sequences of words, can we model sequences of prices or trades. This turns out to be an interesting line of inquiry that reveals much about both generative AI and financial time series modeling. Be warned this will get wonky.
paragraphs.zh: 毫不奇怪，量化交易者们已经提出：我们能否把这些模型用于下一个价格或交易的预测 [1,9,10]？ 也就是说，与其对词语序列建模，我们能否对价格或交易序列建模。 这被证明是一条有趣的研究路径，它同时揭示了关于生成式 AI 和金融时间序列建模的许多东西。 提前提醒，这个话题会比较晦涩难懂。

sents.en: Not surprisingly, quantitative traders have asked: can we turn these models into the next price or trade prediction [1,9,10]?
sents.zh: 毫不奇怪，量化交易者们已经提出：我们能否把这些模型用于下一个价格或交易的预测 [1,9,10]？

sents.en: That is, rather than modeling sequences of words, can we model sequences of prices or trades.
sents.zh: 也就是说，与其对词语序列建模，我们能否对价格或交易序列建模。

sents.en: This turns out to be an interesting line of inquiry that reveals much about both generative AI and financial time series modeling.
sents.zh: 这被证明是一条有趣的研究路径，它同时揭示了关于生成式 AI 和金融时间序列建模的许多东西。

sents.en: Be warned this will get wonky.
sents.zh: 提前提醒，这个话题会比较晦涩难懂。

paragraphs.en: LLMs are known as autoregressive learners -- those using previous tokens or elements in a sequence to predict the next element or token. In quantitative trading, for example in strategies like statistical arbitrage in stocks, most research is concerned with identifying autoregressive structure. That means finding sequences of news or orders or fundamental changes that best predict future prices.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）被称为自回归学习器——即利用序列中先前的词元或元素来预测下一个元素或词元的模型。 以量化交易为例，比如股票中的统计套利策略，大多数研究都致力于识别自回归结构。 这意味着要找到最能预测未来价格的消息序列、订单序列或基本面变化序列。

sents.en: LLMs are known as autoregressive learners -- those using previous tokens or elements in a sequence to predict the next element or token.
sents.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）被称为自回归学习器——即利用序列中先前的词元或元素来预测下一个元素或词元的模型。

sents.en: In quantitative trading, for example in strategies like statistical arbitrage in stocks, most research is concerned with identifying autoregressive structure.
sents.zh: 以量化交易为例，比如股票中的统计套利策略，大多数研究都致力于识别自回归结构。

sents.en: That means finding sequences of news or orders or fundamental changes that best predict future prices.
sents.zh: 这意味着要找到最能预测未来价格的消息序列、订单序列或基本面变化序列。

paragraphs.en: Where things break down is in the quantity and information content of available data to train the models. At the 2023 NeurIPS conference, Hudson River Trading, a high frequency trading firm, presented a comparison of the number of input tokens used to train GPT-3 with the amount of trainable tokens available in the stock market data per year HRT estimated that, with 3,000 tradable stocks, 10 data points per stock per day, 252 trading days per year, and 23400 seconds in a trading day, there are 177 billion stock market tokens per year available as market data. GPT-3 was trained on 500 billion tokens, so not far off [6].
paragraphs.zh: 问题出在用于训练模型的可用数据的数量和信息含量上。 在2023年NeurIPS会议上，高频交易公司Hudson River Trading给出了一项对比：用GPT-3训练所消耗的输入token数量，与股票市场数据中每年可用的可训练token数量。HRT估算，假设有3000只可交易股票、每只股票每天10个数据点、每年252个交易日、每个交易日23400秒，那么每年作为市场数据可用的股票市场token有1770亿个。 GPT-3是在5000亿个token上训练的，所以差距并不大[6]。

sents.en: Where things break down is in the quantity and information content of available data to train the models.
sents.zh: 问题出在用于训练模型的可用数据的数量和信息含量上。

sents.en: GPT-3 was trained on 500 billion tokens, so not far off [6].
sents.zh: GPT-3是在5000亿个token上训练的，所以差距并不大[6]。

paragraphs.en: But, in the trading context the tokens will be prices or returns or trades rather than syllables or words; the former is much more difficult to predict. Language has an underlying linguistic structure (e.g., grammar) [7]. It’s not hard to imagine a human predicting the next word in a sentence, however that same human would find it extremely challenging to predict the next return given a sequence of previous trades, hence the lack of billionaire day traders. The challenge is that there are very smart people competing away any signal in the market, making it almost efficient (“efficiently inefficient”, in the words of economist Lasse Pedersen) and hence unpredictable. No adversary actively tries to make sentences more difficult to predict — if anything, authors usually seek to make their sentences easy to understand and hence more predictable.
paragraphs.zh: 但在交易场景中，令牌将是价格、收益或交易，而不是音节或单词；前者要难预测得多。 语言具有底层的语言学结构（例如语法）[7]。 不难想象一个人预测句子中的下一个单词，然而同一个人会觉得根据之前的交易序列预测下一个收益极其困难，因此也就没有靠日内交易发家致富的亿万富翁。 挑战在于有许多非常聪明的人在竞争中消磨掉市场中的任何信号，使市场近乎有效（用经济学家拉斯·佩德森的话说就是「有效的低效」），因而不可预测。 没有对手会主动设法让句子变得更难预测——如果说有什么不同，作者通常力求让句子易于理解，从而更具可预测性。

paragraphs.en: Looked at from another angle, there is much more noise than signal in financial data. Individuals and institutions are trading for reasons that might not be rational or tied to any fundamental change in a business. The GameStop episode in 2021 is one such example. Financial time series are also constantly changing with new fundamental information, regulatory changes, and occasional large macroeconomic shifts such as currency devaluations. Language evolves at a much slower pace and over longer time horizons.
paragraphs.zh: 换一个角度来看，金融数据中的噪声远多于信号。 个人和机构进行交易的原因可能并不理性，也可能与企业的任何基本面变化无关。 2021 年的游戏驿站（GameStop）事件就是这样一个例子。 金融时间序列还会随着新的基本面信息、监管变化以及货币贬值等偶发的重大宏观经济变化而不断变化。 语言的演化则要缓慢得多，时间跨度也更长。

sents.en: Looked at from another angle, there is much more noise than signal in financial data.
sents.zh: 换一个角度来看，金融数据中的噪声远多于信号。

sents.en: Individuals and institutions are trading for reasons that might not be rational or tied to any fundamental change in a business.
sents.zh: 个人和机构进行交易的原因可能并不理性，也可能与企业的任何基本面变化无关。

sents.zh: 2021 年的游戏驿站（GameStop）事件就是这样一个例子。

sents.zh: 语言的演化则要缓慢得多，时间跨度也更长。

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, there are reasons to believe that ideas from AI will work well in financial markets. One emerging area of AI research with promising applications to finance is multimodal learning [5], which aims to use different modalities of data, for example both images and textual inputs to build a unified model. With OpenAI’s DALL-E 2 model, a user can enter text and the model will generate an image. In finance, multi-modal efforts could be useful to combine information classical sources such as technical time series data (prices, trades, volumes, etc.) with alternative data in different modes like sentiment or graphical interactions on twitter, natural language news articles and corporate reports, or the satellite images of shipping activity in a commodity centric port. Here, leveraging multi-modal AI, one could potentially incorporate all these types of non-price information to predict well.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，我们有理由相信来自人工智能的思想在金融市场中能够很好地发挥作用。 多模态学习[5]是人工智能研究中一个新兴的、在金融领域具有前景应用的领域，其目标是使用不同模态的数据，例如同时使用图像和文本输入来构建一个统一的模型。 借助 OpenAI 的 DALL-E 2 模型，用户可以输入文本，模型将生成一幅图像。 在金融领域，多模态工作可以有助于将经典来源的信息（如技术时间序列数据：价格、交易、成交量等）与不同模态的另类数据相结合，例如推特上的情绪或图形化互动、自然语言新闻文章和公司报告，或以大宗商品为中心的港口的航运活动卫星图像。 在这里，利用多模态人工智能，人们有可能将所有这些类型的非价格信息纳入其中，从而实现良好的预测。

sents.en: On the other hand, there are reasons to believe that ideas from AI will work well in financial markets.
sents.zh: 另一方面，我们有理由相信来自人工智能的思想在金融市场中能够很好地发挥作用。

sents.zh: 多模态学习[5]是人工智能研究中一个新兴的、在金融领域具有前景应用的领域，其目标是使用不同模态的数据，例如同时使用图像和文本输入来构建一个统一的模型。

sents.zh: 借助 OpenAI 的 DALL-E 2 模型，用户可以输入文本，模型将生成一幅图像。

paragraphs.en: Another strategy called ‘residualization’ holds prominence in both finance and AI, though it assumes different roles in the two domains. In finance, structural `factor’ models break down the contemporaneous observations of returns across different assets into a shared component (the market return, or more generally returns of common, market-wide factors) and an idiosyncratic component unique to each underlying asset. Market and factor returns are difficult to predict and create interdependence, so it is often helpful to remove the common element when making predictions at the individual asset level and to maximize the number of independent observations in the data.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种被称为「残差化」的策略在金融和人工智能领域都占有重要地位，尽管它在这两个领域中扮演着不同的角色。 在金融领域，结构化「因子」模型将不同资产的同期收益观测分解为一个共同成分（即市场收益，或更广义的整个市场范围内的共同因子收益）和每个标的资产特有的特异成分。 市场收益和因子收益难以预测，并且会带来相互依赖性，因此在单个资产层面进行预测时，剔除共同成分往往是有帮助的，同时也可以最大化数据中独立观测的数量。

sents.en: Another strategy called ‘residualization’ holds prominence in both finance and AI, though it assumes different roles in the two domains.
sents.zh: 另一种被称为「残差化」的策略在金融和人工智能领域都占有重要地位，尽管它在这两个领域中扮演着不同的角色。

paragraphs.en: In residual network architectures such as transformers, there’s a similar idea that we want to learn a function h(X) of an input X, but it might be easier to learn the residual of h(X) to the identity map, i.e., h(X) – X. Here, if the function h(X) is close to identity, its residual will be close to zero, and hence there will be less to learn and learning can be done more efficiently. In both cases the goal is to exploit structure to refine predictions: in the finance case, the idea is to focus on predicting innovations beyond what is implied by the overall market, for residual networks the focus is on predicting innovations to the identity map.
paragraphs.zh: 在诸如 Transformer 这样的残差网络架构中，有一个类似的想法：我们想学习输入 X 的一个函数 h(X)，但学习 h(X) 相对于恒等映射的残差可能更容易，即 h(X) – X。 这里，如果函数 h(X) 接近恒等映射，其残差将接近于零，因此需要学习的内容更少，学习也可以更高效地进行。 在这两种情况下，目标都是利用结构来改进预测：在金融的例子中，重点是预测超出整体市场所隐含内容的新息；对于残差网络，重点是预测相对于恒等映射的新息。

sents.en: In residual network architectures such as transformers, there’s a similar idea that we want to learn a function h(X) of an input X, but it might be easier to learn the residual of h(X) to the identity map, i.e., h(X) – X.
sents.zh: 在诸如 Transformer 这样的残差网络架构中，有一个类似的想法：我们想学习输入 X 的一个函数 h(X)，但学习 h(X) 相对于恒等映射的残差可能更容易，即 h(X) – X。

sents.en: Here, if the function h(X) is close to identity, its residual will be close to zero, and hence there will be less to learn and learning can be done more efficiently.
sents.zh: 这里，如果函数 h(X) 接近恒等映射，其残差将接近于零，因此需要学习的内容更少，学习也可以更高效地进行。

sents.en: In both cases the goal is to exploit structure to refine predictions: in the finance case, the idea is to focus on predicting innovations beyond what is implied by the overall market, for residual networks the focus is on predicting innovations to the identity map.
sents.zh: 在这两种情况下，目标都是利用结构来改进预测：在金融的例子中，重点是预测超出整体市场所隐含内容的新息；对于残差网络，重点是预测相对于恒等映射的新息。

paragraphs.en: A key ingredient for the impressive performance of LLMs work is their ability to discern affinities or strengths between tokens over long horizons known as context windows. In financial markets, the ability to focus attention across long horizons enables analysis of multi-scale phenomena, with some aspects of market changes explained across very different time horizons. For example, at one extreme, fundamental information (e.g., earnings) may be incorporated into prices over months, technical phenomena (e.g., momentum) might be realized over days, and, at the other extreme, microstructure phenomena (e.g., order book imbalance) might have a time horizon of seconds to minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）取得令人瞩目的表现，其关键因素之一在于能够识别长跨度（即上下文窗口）内词元之间的关联或强度。 在金融市场中，跨长周期聚焦注意力的能力使得多尺度现象分析成为可能，因为市场变化的某些方面可以在截然不同的时间跨度上得到解释。 例如，在一个极端情况下，基本面信息（如盈利）可能需要数月才能反映到价格中；技术面现象（如动量）可能在数天内显现；而在另一个极端，微观结构现象（如订单簿失衡）的时间跨度可能只有几秒到几分钟。

sents.en: A key ingredient for the impressive performance of LLMs work is their ability to discern affinities or strengths between tokens over long horizons known as context windows.
sents.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）取得令人瞩目的表现，其关键因素之一在于能够识别长跨度（即上下文窗口）内词元之间的关联或强度。

sents.en: In financial markets, the ability to focus attention across long horizons enables analysis of multi-scale phenomena, with some aspects of market changes explained across very different time horizons.

sents.en: For example, at one extreme, fundamental information (e.g., earnings) may be incorporated into prices over months, technical phenomena (e.g., momentum) might be realized over days, and, at the other extreme, microstructure phenomena (e.g., order book imbalance) might have a time horizon of seconds to minutes.
sents.zh: 例如，在一个极端情况下，基本面信息（如盈利）可能需要数月才能反映到价格中；技术面现象（如动量）可能在数天内显现；而在另一个极端，微观结构现象（如订单簿失衡）的时间跨度可能只有几秒到几分钟。

paragraphs.en: Capturing all of these phenomena involves analysis of multiple time horizons across the context window. However, in finance, prediction over multiple future time horizons is also important. For example, a quantitative system may seek to trade to profit from multiple different anomalies that are realized over multiple time horizons (e.g., simultaneously betting on a microstructure event and an earnings event). This requires predicting not just the next period return of the stock, but the entire term structure or trajectory of expected returns, while current transformer-style predictive models only look one period in the future.
paragraphs.zh: 要捕捉所有这些现象，需要对上下文窗口内的多个时间跨度进行分析。 然而，在金融领域，对未来多个时间跨度的预测同样重要。 例如，一个量化系统可能试图通过交易来从多个不同异常中获利，这些异常会在多个时间跨度上实现（例如，同时押注一个微观结构事件和一个财报事件）。 这不仅要求预测股票下一期的收益，还要求预测预期收益的完整期限结构或轨迹，而目前的 transformer 式预测模型只能前瞻一期。

sents.en: Capturing all of these phenomena involves analysis of multiple time horizons across the context window.
sents.zh: 要捕捉所有这些现象，需要对上下文窗口内的多个时间跨度进行分析。

sents.en: However, in finance, prediction over multiple future time horizons is also important.
sents.zh: 然而，在金融领域，对未来多个时间跨度的预测同样重要。

sents.en: For example, a quantitative system may seek to trade to profit from multiple different anomalies that are realized over multiple time horizons (e.g., simultaneously betting on a microstructure event and an earnings event).
sents.zh: 例如，一个量化系统可能试图通过交易来从多个不同异常中获利，这些异常会在多个时间跨度上实现（例如，同时押注一个微观结构事件和一个财报事件）。

sents.en: This requires predicting not just the next period return of the stock, but the entire term structure or trajectory of expected returns, while current transformer-style predictive models only look one period in the future.
sents.zh: 这不仅要求预测股票下一期的收益，还要求预测预期收益的完整期限结构或轨迹，而目前的 transformer 式预测模型只能前瞻一期。

paragraphs.en: Another financial market application of LLMs might be synthetic data creation [4,8]. This could take a few directions. Simulated stock price trajectories can be generated that mimic characteristics observed in the market and can be extremely beneficial given that financial market data is scarce relative to other sources as highlighted above in the number of tokens available. Artificial data could open the door for meta-learning techniques which have successfully been applied, for example, in robotics. In the robotic setting controllers are first trained using cheap but not necessarily accurate physics simulators, before being better calibrated using expensive real world experiments with robots. In finance the simulators could be used to coarsely train and optimize trading strategies. The model would learn high level concepts like risk aversion and diversification and tactical concepts such as trading slowly to minimize the price impact of a trade. Then precious real market data could be employed to fine-tune the predictions and determine precisely the optimal speed to trade.
paragraphs.zh: LLMs 在金融市场的另一个应用可能是合成数据创建 [4,8]。 这可以有以下几个方向。 可以生成模拟股票价格轨迹，以模仿市场中观察到的特征，鉴于如上文可用 token 数量所强调的，金融市场数据相对于其他数据来源较为稀缺，这类数据可能极为有益。 人工数据可以为元学习技术打开大门，这类技术已在例如机器人学等领域得到成功应用。 在机器人场景中，控制器先使用廉价但不一定精确的物理模拟器进行训练，然后再使用昂贵的真实世界机器人实验进行更好的校准。 在金融领域，模拟器可用于粗略地训练和优化交易策略。 智能体会学习诸如风险厌恶与分散化之类的高层概念，以及诸如缓慢交易以最小化交易价格冲击之类的战术性概念。 然后，可以利用珍贵的真实市场数据来微调预测，并精确确定最优交易速度。

paragraphs.en: Financial market practitioners are often interested in extreme events, the times when trading strategies are more likely to experience significant gains or losses. Generative models where it’s possible to sample from extreme scenarios could find use. However extreme events by definition occur rarely and hence determining the right parameters and sampling data from the corresponding distribution is fraught.
paragraphs.zh: 金融市场的从业者往往对极端事件很感兴趣，也就是交易策略更有可能获得重大收益或遭受重大损失的时期。 能够从极端场景中进行采样的生成模型可能会派上用场。 然而极端事件顾名思义很少发生，因此确定正确的参数并从相应的分布中采样数据是困难重重的事情。

paragraphs.en: Despite the skepticism that LLMs will find use in quantitative trading, they might boost fundamental analysis. As AI models improve, it’s easy to imagine them helping analysts refine an investment thesis, uncover inconsistencies in management commentary or find latent relationships between tangential industries and businesses [3]. Essentially these models could provide a Charlie Munger for every investor.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管人们对大语言模型（LLM）能否在量化交易中找到用途持怀疑态度，但它们可能会促进基本面分析。 随着AI模型的改进，很容易想象它们帮助分析师完善投资论点、发现管理层评论中的不一致之处，或者找出相邻行业与企业之间潜在的关系 [3]。 从本质上讲，这些模型可以为每位投资者提供一个查理·芒格。

sents.en: Despite the skepticism that LLMs will find use in quantitative trading, they might boost fundamental analysis.
sents.zh: 尽管人们对大语言模型（LLM）能否在量化交易中找到用途持怀疑态度，但它们可能会促进基本面分析。

sents.zh: 从本质上讲，这些模型可以为每位投资者提供一个查理·芒格。

paragraphs.en: The surprising thing about the current generative AI revolution is that it’s taken almost everyone – academic researchers, cutting edge technology firms and long-time observers – by surprise. The idea that building bigger and bigger models would lead to emergent capabilities like we see today was totally unexpected and still not fully understood.
paragraphs.zh: 当前这场生成式 AI 革命令人惊讶的地方在于，它几乎让所有人都感到意外——包括学术研究者、前沿科技公司以及长期观察者。 构建越来越大的模型会产生我们如今所见的涌现能力，这一想法完全出乎预料，而且至今仍未被充分理解。

sents.en: The surprising thing about the current generative AI revolution is that it’s taken almost everyone – academic researchers, cutting edge technology firms and long-time observers – by surprise.
sents.zh: 当前这场生成式 AI 革命令人惊讶的地方在于，它几乎让所有人都感到意外——包括学术研究者、前沿科技公司以及长期观察者。

sents.en: The idea that building bigger and bigger models would lead to emergent capabilities like we see today was totally unexpected and still not fully understood.
sents.zh: 构建越来越大的模型会产生我们如今所见的涌现能力，这一想法完全出乎预料，而且至今仍未被充分理解。

paragraphs.en: The success of these AI models has supercharged the flow of human and financial capital into AI, which should in turn lead to even better and more capable models. So while the case for GPT-4 like models taking over quantitative trading is currently unlikely, we advocate keeping an open mind. Expecting the unexpected has been a profitable theme in the AI business.
paragraphs.zh: 这些 AI 模型的成功极大加速了人力与金融资本流入 AI 领域，而这反过来又将催生更优秀、更强大的模型。 因此，尽管 GPT-4 类型的模型接管量化交易的可能性目前看来不大，我们仍主张保持开放的心态。 预料到意外之事一直是 AI 行业中一个有利可图的主题。
